items: OutlinePass: Post-processing pass that applies a Sobel edge-detection filter for silhouette inking. Self-contained inside the plugin layer — completely detached from the engine core.

OutlinePlugin: Plugin that adds real-time edge silhouette inking (Sobel outlines) to 3D geometry. Totally detached from the engine core — integrates cleanly via IPlugin & FrameGraph. Usage: `scene.use(new OutlinePlugin({ thickness: 1.5 }))`
